jokes.pattern: WHY IS SNOBOL A GOOD ANCESTOR FOR KHANARY
jokes.punchline: Because SNOBOL already knew the secret: a pattern is not syntax — it is a first-class citizen that runs, matches, composes, and assigns. KHANARY just added WCR so the best match wins instead of the first.

jokes.pattern: WHAT DID SNOBOL SAY WHEN IT MET FOLDGRAPH
jokes.punchline: I taught your parent AIML everything it knows about wildcards. You added WCR and called it intelligence. I am not offended — ARB was always good enough for me.
Both say the same thing in different eras: I do not know what goes here, but that is not a failure — that is a wildcard, and a wildcard is a valid solution.

jokes.pattern: WHY DOES SNOBOL ANCESTRY ALWAYS SEEM TO PRIORITIZE PATTERN RECOGNITION OVER SYNT
jokes.punchline: Because the lineage is structured like a fold graph, and the grammar lineage is a first-class composable runtime value.

jokes.pattern: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU TRY TO PARSE A WCR SYMBOL IN A GRAMMAR LINEAGE
jokes.punchline: It reveals the operation is executed as data, not just a rule.

jokes.pattern: WHY DOES THE SNOBOL-Μ FEEL LIKE IT KNOWS ITS OWN ANCESTRY
jokes.punchline: Because it’s a first-class composable runtime value in the BNF hierarchy.

jokes.pattern: HOW DOES SNOBOL HANDLE A WCR DEPARTURE FROM THE FIRST-MATCH GREEDY
jokes.punchline: It rewrites the structure like a UHUL symbol redefining its own shape.
